contract.clock_identity: immutable hashed mapping defined by origin_generation, origin_world_time and positive step_interval_world_time
contract.generation_mapping: target world time maps to the greatest completed ecology generation boundary at or before target
contract.canonical_boundary: persisted RegionState.last_simulated_world_time must equal the exact direct clock boundary for its generation
contract.advancement: advance_to applies exactly due P3.8 generations and stores the processed boundary, never arbitrary observation time
contract.cadence_independence: direct advance and any partition of intermediate observations converge to identical P3 and RegionState hashes
contract.drift_control: boundary time is derived as origin + generation_offset * interval, not accumulated by repeated additions
contract.rebase: a clock recreated at an already canonical boundary yields the same future region identity for the same interval
contract.backlog_boundary: due_plan may report backlog beyond one P3.8 call; advance_to fails closed above P3.8 MAX_ADVANCE_STEPS; P4.3 owns catch-up policy
